_info: D107: głosy ElevenLabs mówców bez imienia (nv_*) w wersji produkcyjnej m4. `brief`: kto i jak mówi (z kontekstu wszystkich kwestii, bez tekstu gry); `el`: opis do text_to_voice (MCP). Projekt i wybór głosów według skilla elevenlabs, za zgodą użytkownika; potem voice_id w direction.ELEVEN_VOICES_PROD. Portret z gry (D41) dopisujemy, gdy postać go ma.

nv_protektor.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Male, 40-50. Persona: protector of a fortress talking with a baroness on the road. Emotion: respectful, earnest. Steady, moderate baritone.

nv_q14_zolnierka.brief: uwięziona żołnierka Forthynu; zmęczona, posiniaczona, ulga i nadzieja

nv_ta2_mag.brief: arogancki uczony mag z zepsutym wozem; wyniosły, zniecierpliwiony, protekcjonalny
nv_ta2_mag.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Male, 45-55. Persona: arrogant scholarly mage stuck with a broken wagon. Emotion: haughty, impatient, condescending. Pompous, nasal, theatrical voice.

nv_ta2_orczyca.brief: zawadiacka orczyca karciarka; urocza, pewna siebie, puszcza oko
nv_ta2_orczyca.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Female, 25-35, orc card shark. Emotion: charming, cocky, winking. Low, playful, husky voice.

nv_ta2_pielgrzym.brief: krasnolud z grupy pielgrzymów; zmęczony, zatroskany, krasnoludzki
nv_ta2_pielgrzym.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Male, 60-70, dwarf pilgrim. Emotion: tired, worried. Deep, gravelly, earthy voice.

nv_ta2_sierzant.brief: ranny sierżant eskorty uchodźców; zmęczony, wojskowy, salutuje
nv_ta2_sierzant.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Male, 45-55. Persona: wounded sergeant escorting refugees. Emotion: tired, soldierly, saluting. Hoarse, firm baritone.

nv_ta2_sluzacy.brief: służący w przydrożnej gospodzie; uprzejmy, usłużny
nv_ta2_sluzacy.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Male, 25-35. Persona: servant in a roadside inn. Emotion: polite, obliging. Light, smooth tenor.

nv_uchodzca.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Female, 25-35. Persona: refugee on the road. Emotion: desperate, pleading. High, worried voice.

nv_warrick.brief: Warrick, stary ork-rolnik; ciepły gawędziarz, zmęczone kości, podnosi ludzi na duchu, opowiada historie o duchach
nv_warrick.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Male, 65-75, orc farmer. Persona: old storyteller who cheers people up with ghost stories. Emotion: warm, folksy, chuckling. Deep, gravelly, rumbling bass, slow and cosy.

nv_widmo.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Female, ancient wraith shouting in combat. Emotion: hateful, mournful. Low, raspy, whispering, echoing voice.

nv_wiesniak.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Male, 65-75. Persona: freed old villager. Emotion: grateful, shaky. Thin, creaky old voice.

nv_wiezien.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Male, 25-35. Persona: freed prisoner. Emotion: relieved, nervous. Plain, moderate tenor.

nv_xain.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Male, 25-35, dragon-blooded brood lieutenant boss. Emotion: arrogant, menacing. Very deep, growling bass.

nv_zarzadczyni.brief: zarządczyni zamku Highmont; opanowana, zdyszana, oddana służąca baronessy
nv_zarzadczyni.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Female, 50-60. Persona: castle stewardess, devoted servant of a baroness. Emotion: composed but breathless, efficient. Clear, proper, mid-low voice.

nv_zerai.brief: porucznik Zerai, smocza hybryda w zbroi oficera (kobieta); drwiąca, pewna siebie
nv_zerai.el: Native Polish. Studio quality. Female, 35-45, dragon-blooded hybrid lieutenant in officer armour. Emotion: mocking, confident. Cold, metallic, low alto.
